findings.rationale: Folded: P4 G arm runs the rail adapter (fresh-process repair at the dispatch turn boundary) against a comparable C arm, harness and adapter hashes frozen before the first pair; a P4 result supports promoting the rail adapter only; Stop/SubagentStop adapters need their own evidence (P4 row, section 5 risk, KR4).

Folded: new prerequisite phase P3b fixes BL-0254 in the t14 batch driver (at most 3 attempts per run, last non-infra attempt is the valid row, fewer than 27 valid rows is INCONCLUSIVE) with a seeded infra-failure acceptance test; P4 may not start until P3b passes (P3b row, KR4, P4 procedure).

Folded: retry budget is per lineage (2 per turn, 6 cumulative per lineage); a different-engine redispatch or a depth-0 repair stays in the same lineage and cannot reset it; exhaustion opens an owner card (sections 2, 3.5, 3.7, KR1).
Folded: P5 promotion eligibility and any P6 default-change proposal require P1 complete (C-arm evidence table plus discriminating test); P4 may run in parallel with P1 (P5, P6 rows, P4 acceptance).
Folded: 3.9 moved into Design before section 4; trailing substantive paragraphs moved into sections 3.1 and 6; the review log is the final section.
Folded: section 0 states round 2 had two infra failures, G-15 runner_timeout and C-16 runner_error (OAuth expired mid-run).
Folded: section 1 self-references now resolve within section 1; P3b/P4 name the BL-0254 driver as the component enforcing the rerun rule.
